scripts.build: npm run build -w @event/shared && npm run build -w @event/api && npm run build -w @event/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @event/shared && npm run typecheck -w @event/api && npm run typecheck -w @event/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @event/shared && npm run test -w @event/api
scripts.test:deployment: node --test scripts/production-processes.test.mjs && npm run test -w @event/api -- test/config.test.ts
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @event/shared && npm run seed -w @event/api
